subject: Public utilities: electric utilities
bill.title: Public utilities: electric utilities; project labor agreements and prevailing wage and fringe benefit rates; require for certain data center contracts. Amends 1939 PA 3 (MCL 460.1 - 460.11) by adding sec. 10ii.

posted_text:
🏢 MI SB 1048 — Data Centers Must Pay Union Wages in Michigan

Michigan is changing how electric utilities build data centers. Starting soon, any contract between an electric utility and a data center developer will need to include specific requirements. The utility must use apprenticeship programs registered with the Department of Labor, and workers must be paid at least the prevailing wage and fringe benefits for the area, as determined by state law. ...
